usedFor: Todoist holds your tasks, and Teable mirrors them as rows when “Create Record” follows “New Task Created in Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Created in Project” in Todoist, then “Create Record” in Teable
bestTemplate.why: Every new task in a chosen project adds a Teable row, so you can report on them.

watchOut: “New Task Created in Project” is polling, so rows show up after a scheduled check.
